raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 card collector, rolled out from 2026-01-15, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. As a result, v2 evening transactions land at 00:00-06:00 and some spill into the next day (2026-01-19). All data falls in January, when Chicago is on CST (UTC-6, no DST), so shifting v2 timestamps back 6 hours aligns them with the legacy local-time convention; the v2 samples at 12:00 UTC become 06:00 local, which matches opening hours.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
